title: Bellaire Medical: older patient with a walker in the big open area, far from the exits

lines.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?
Sixty five fifty Mapleridge Street, the medical building in Bellaire. There's smoke coming from the back hallway near the rear door.
No, there's an older man with a walker still in the big open area in the middle of the building. He's confused and he can't find the way out.
Can he walk on his own?
Very slowly, only with the walker. I can't get to him, the smoke is in the way.
Stay where you are. Help is on the way.
